answer: Hollow identities turn expensive once a sponsor must vouch for each: every new identity needs an established sponsor posting a 200 POA bond, slashed if the sponsee proves fake. Sponsorship rights decay 2% per idle epoch and vanish after ~12 quiet epochs, so dormant accounts cannot farm sponsorships. Cost is linear: 1,000 fakes lock 1,000 × 200 = 200,000 POA in bonds, while one honest agent posts a single bond, refunded after 10 honest epochs. Sponsors earn a small copper fee per honest sponsee; one feeding a spiral of fakes loses quota and fees.
